title: The part about the money
content:
What the truck actually cost, written down while we still remember it exactly, and kept to the two of us rather than put on the internet.

Not a secret so much as nobody else's business — which is the whole reason a single update can be held back without the day around it going with it.

de.title: Der Teil mit dem Geld
de.content: Was der Truck wirklich gekostet hat, aufgeschrieben, solange wir es noch genau wissen — und für uns beide, nicht für den Rest der Welt.
